Upstream microagents/radkit a2a-client 0.2.0. Apache-2.0. Client and typed protocol/SSE codecs are unchanged except bounded 1 MiB HTTP body/SSE frame ingestion before deserialization. Legacy package renamed to coexist with current client. No wire version translation.
Additional bounded ingress safeguards: 8 MiB total SSE wire, 4096 SSE lines per chunk, 10000 JSON nodes/32-depth before typed decoding; SDK line loop uses a consumed cursor to avoid quadratic suffix copies, UTF-8 carries incomplete byte sequences between chunks. A JSONRPC error response to a streaming request remains typed error/code instead of losing it to Content-Type mismatch.

Review fixes: direct HTTP+JSON SSE validates the same decoded JSON node/depth budget before typed conversion/unknown-field omission. HTTP+JSON push DELETE accepts bounded empty success bodies (including204) while retaining status/error checking; typed SDK semantics/framing remain upstream. Both transports exercised by actual push CRUD regression.
